referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Electricity from wind farm, fed to grid. Includes the operation of the wind farm with the necessary change of gear oil. A leackage of 5% of SF6 is assumed over the entire life cycle of the wind farm. The modelled 150 MW wind farm is based on the Ormonde offshore wind farm, UK, consisting of 30 REpower 5M wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 5 MW and jacket substructure, as well as 1 offshore substation. The distance to service port is 10 km. Total length of export cables is 129 km (assuming 3 parallel export cables of 43 km each). The total length of array cables is 27 km. The model uses a capacity factor of 34.1%, representing the average capacity factor of offshore wind farms in Europe between 2016-2024 (source: ENTSO-E). Assumed lifetime is 25 years. Annual electricity production is 448 GWh, applying a capacity factor of 34.1%.
